description: This PHP trait, IndexingLockFileTrait, provides functionality for reading and writing lock files used for indexing processes within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to read a lock file, write a timestamp to it, check file accessibility, and generate the lock filename based on the class name. The trait is designed to be used with indexer classes to manage concurrency or locking during indexing operations.

methods.name: readLockFile
methods.description: Reads the lock file, returning a Carbon timestamp indicating the last indexing time, or false if the file doesn't exist or can't be read.

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Generates and returns the lock file path based on the class's short name or fallback class name.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Checks if a given filename exists and is readable.

methods.name: writeLockFile
methods.description: Writes the current timestamp to the lock file to update its last modified time.

methods.name: formatInterval
methods.description: Formats a number of seconds into a human-readable interval string.
